{{Quote|This ship carries the Crest of Alderaan! Is any of the Royal Family on board?|Darth Vader|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 1">[[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars'' (1977) 1]]</ref>}}
The '''monarch of Alderaan''' was the [[King/Legends|king]] or [[Queen/Legends|queen]] reigning over the planet of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. They were chosen by and among the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]]. Years before the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]] was founded, the monarch was officially elected and anointed in the [[Elysium]], a stone hall located in the [[Glarus Valley]]. The first monarch of Alderaan, King [[Darrus Alde|Darrus]], belonged to [[House Alde]].<ref name="King's Pass">{{TORcite|type=codex|King's Pass}}</ref> His successors included scions of [[House Panteer]], the [[House Ulgo]]<ref name="Bouris">{{TORcite|type=codex|Bouris Ulgo}}</ref> and the [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]]. The latter had remained the ruling dynasty for decades when Alderaan was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|111|Royal House of Alderaan}}</ref>
